response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL AND s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT a.equipstatus, a.avg_pulse_rate, a.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS a CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE a.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept), second_kept AS (SELECT k.avg_pulse_rate, k.excess_first, k.avg_pulse_rate - m.mean_rate AS excess_second FROM first_kept AS k CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > m.mean_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_rate, AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_second FROM second_kept

assumptions.assumption: A missing equipment status is excluded because it does not identify a status.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat missing equipment status as its own group.
